jobs.description: As a Care Worker (Verzorgende IG) in Bladel, you will provide dedicated elderly care in a welcoming, small-scale residential setting with 21 apartments. You support residents with personal hygiene, dressing, mobility and other daily activities while encouraging them to remain as independent as possible. Your responsibilities also include administering medication, carrying out nursing procedures within your qualifications and monitoring residents' physical and emotional well-being. You recognize changes in health conditions, document your observations and discuss appropriate care with colleagues. Working in a close-knit team, you help create a safe and comfortable home where residents receive individual attention. We are looking for an English-speaking healthcare professional who already lives in the Netherlands, has at least one year of care experience and holds a relevant healthcare diploma, including an eligible foreign qualification. Official diploma recognition must be arranged before starting, and support is available. You can work 16 to 32 hours weekly and receive a direct employment contract with the care organization. Employment conditions follow the Dutch CAO VVT. Interested in meaningful elderly care where your contribution matters? Apply for this Verzorgende IG position in Bladel through WIJ.ZORGEN. For information, call 085 060 3432.

As an orbital welding operator, you will work with various advanced welding processes and contribute to the production of high-quality stainless steel assemblies. Based on technical drawings and production planning, you will independently carry out work orders while ensuring precision and quality throughout the entire process.In this role, you will prepare and process components, perform orbital and TIG welding activities, and work with technologies such as laser welding and laser marking. You will manufacture and assemble stainless steel hoses, couplings, bends, and other complex components using orbital welding heads, welding robots, and manual manipulators.You will also be responsible for performing helium leak tests and final quality inspections to ensure all products meet the highest industry standards. In addition, you will set up and adjust machines when required and carry out first-line maintenance to support a smooth and efficient production process.Besides the hands-on technical work, you will complete work orders digitally within the system and contribute to the development and improvement of new products and production methods.
